integrity: General proof is analytic via Dirichlet moments and digamma monotonicity. The standalone finite exact checker is a diagnostic, not exhaustive certification or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional strictly positive Dirichlet concentrations; covariance only, no stochastic order or maximizer classification. Historical priority subject to unlocated joint-index literature.
title: Universal negative Shannon–Simpson covariance under asymmetric Dirichlet laws
